她提前看过这一段，到点会搭话。: She has previewed this part and will chime in at the right moments.
她边看边听。: She is watching and listening along.
打开后她平时就知道电脑上发生了什么，不用你说「看一下」。她只看和听，不会因此动你: When on, she knows what's happening on your computer without you asking her to look. She only sees and hears, and won't operate your computer because of it. Off by default.
前台窗口的标题、开着哪些程序、在做什么。约 4 秒看一次，只留在内存里。: The foreground window title, which programs are open and what you are doing. Checked about every 4 seconds and kept in memory only.
你说话或陪看时，把当前窗口的小图一起给她，要预设里放了屏幕图才会带。会多花模型额: Sends her a small image of the current window when you talk or watch together, only if the preset includes the screen image. Uses more model quota.
有程序出声且分得清是谁时，才在本机转成文字。分不清就只知道有声音。声音不发给任何: Transcribes on this computer only when a program is playing sound and the source is clear. Otherwise she only knows there's sound. Audio is never sent to any cloud service.
可以自己开口: Can speak up on her own
你回到电脑前、换了程序待一阵这类时候，她可以说两句，也可以不说。只说话，不动手。: When you come back to the computer or settle into another program, she may say something, or nothing. She only talks and takes no action.
她最多多久自己开口一次。: How often she can speak up on her own at most.
少（至少隔 1 小时，每天 6 次）: Low (at least 1 hour apart, 6 per day)
中（至少隔 30 分钟，每天 12 次）: Medium (at least 30 minutes apart, 12 per day)
多（至少隔 15 分钟，每天 24 次）: High (at least 15 minutes apart, 24 per day)
B 站和 YouTube 能提前看好、到点搭话；别的网站和本地播放器边看边听。: On Bilibili and YouTube she can preview and chime in at the right moments. On other sites and local players she watches and listens along.
确认在播放才进入，屏幕顶部会提示 5 秒，可以马上退出。全屏打游戏不会进入。: Starts only when playback is confirmed. A notice shows at the top of the screen for 5 seconds so you can exit right away. Fullscreen games don't trigger it.
她平时能知道电脑上的什么：看、听、自己开口、陪看和要保护的程序。: What she can know about your computer: seeing, hearing, speaking up, watching along and protected programs.
感知只能在桌面客户端里设置。下面「她的地方」「信任」「高级」在这里也能用。: Perception can only be set in the desktop client. "Her places", "Trust" and "Advanced" below also work here.
感知暂停：电脑在休眠: Perception paused: the computer is asleep
感知暂停：当前是敏感窗口: Perception paused: a sensitive window is in front
今天开口 {0} 次，感知叫醒 {1} / {2} 次，主动回合 {3} / {: Today: spoke {0} times, woken by perception {1} / {2}, proactive turns {3} / {4}.
没检测到浏览器扩展（打开 B 站或 YouTube 后才检测得到）。没装时陪看走: Browser extension not detected (it shows up after you open Bilibili or YouTube). Without it, watching along still works in follow mode.
安装：在 Thorium、Chrome、Edge 这类 Chromium 浏览器: To install: in a Chromium browser such as Thorium, Chrome, or Edge, open the extensions page (chrome://extensions; edge://extensions in Edge), turn on Developer mode, choose "Load unpacked", and pick the folder that just opened. Restart the browser once afterwards.
没连上浏览器扩展，不能提前看，隔一阵才说一句。: The browser extension is not connected, so she cannot watch ahead and only speaks now and then.
预读工具没装好，不能提前看，隔一阵才说一句。去设置里一键安装。: The pre-read tools are not installed, so she cannot watch ahead and only speaks now and then. Install them in Settings.
这段没能提前看，先边看边听，隔一阵才说一句。: She could not watch this part ahead, so she is following along and speaks now and then.
现在听不到声音：看看「允许她听」开了没有，听写模型下载了没有。: She cannot hear anything right now: check that "Allow her to listen" is on and the transcription model is downloaded.
浏览器扩展版本旧了，重启一次浏览器就会更新。先边看边说。: The browser extension is outdated; restart the browser once to update it. She is following along for now.
连接浏览器扩展的组件没能启动，不能提前看，先边看边说。: The component that connects to the browser extension failed to start, so she cannot watch ahead and is following along.
这段视频没取到，先边看边说。: This part of the video could not be fetched, so she is following along.
这段没写出台词，先边看边说。: No lines came out for this part, so she is following along.
这段她既看不到画面也没有字幕，所以不提前写。开听写模型或换能看图的模型会好。: She has neither picture nor subtitles for this part, so nothing is written ahead. A transcription model or a vision model would help.
正在提前看这一段，先边看边说。: Watching this part ahead; following along for now.
浏览器扩展版本旧了，重启一次浏览器就会更新。: The browser extension is outdated; restart the browser once to update it.
B 站没登录时拿不到字幕，她就只有画面。打开后扩展把 B 站或 YouTube: Without a login, Bilibili subtitles are unavailable and she only has the picture. When on, the extension syncs your Bilibili or YouTube login to the local downloader. It is only used to fetch video and subtitles, and is never sent to the model or online. Turning this off deletes it.
连不上 GitHub。确认代理开着（Clash 要开系统代理）后再点一键安装。: Cannot reach GitHub. Make sure your proxy is on (Clash needs system proxy enabled), then click Install again.
下载太慢超时了。换个代理节点后再点一键安装。: The download was too slow and timed out. Try another proxy node, then click Install again.
下载的文件校验不通过，可能是下载不完整。再点一次一键安装。: The downloaded file failed verification and may be incomplete. Click Install again.
文件写不进去。看看磁盘空间，或者杀毒软件有没有拦下这个文件夹。: Could not write the files. Check disk space, or whether antivirus is blocking this folder.
下载的压缩包内容不对，可能是上游改了格式。把下面的报错发给开发者。: The downloaded archive looks wrong; the upstream format may have changed. Send the error below to the developer.
也可以自己下载 ffmpeg.exe 和 yt-dlp.exe 放进工具文件夹，: You can also download ffmpeg.exe and yt-dlp.exe yourself and put them in the tools folder. They take effect after restarting infOS.
听不到声音：设置里「允许她听」关着。: She cannot hear: "Allow her to listen" is off in Settings.
听不到声音：听写模型还没下载好。: She cannot hear: the transcription model is not ready.
听不到声音，这个视频可能没在出声。: She cannot hear; this video may not be making sound.

这段台词没写成，模型回复是空的。先边看边说。: Lines for this part failed: the model replied with nothing. Following along for now.
这段没认出台词，先边看边说。她回的是：{0}: Could not read any lines, following along for now. She replied: {0}
她刚才想说话但失败了：{0}: She tried to speak but failed: {0}
她上一次判断没什么好说的，或者模型回复是空的。: Last time she had nothing to say, or the model replied with nothing.
这个视频取不到，先边看边说。原因：{0}: Could not fetch this video, following along for now. Reason: {0}
网页视频能下载的就提前看好、到点搭话；下不了的网站和本地播放器边看边听。: Web videos that can be downloaded are watched ahead so she speaks on time; other sites and local players are followed live.
任何网站的视频放起来就进入，屏幕顶部提示 5 秒，可以马上退出。音乐软件、静音预: Starts as soon as a video plays on any site, with a 5-second notice at the top so you can exit. Music apps, muted previews, and fullscreen games do not count.
浏览器扩展已连接：网页视频能下载的就用预读。: Browser extension connected: downloadable web videos use pre-read.
没检测到浏览器扩展（放一个视频后才检测得到）。没装的话陪看时走跟看，也能用。: Browser extension not detected (it shows up once a video plays). Without it, watch-along follows live and still works.
